title: Coin Combinations
statement: A vending machine accepts coins of n different values, with an unlimited supply of each. Count the number of different combinations of coins (order does not matter) that add up to the amount.
input_format: The first line contains n and amount. The second line contains n distinct coin values.
output_format: Print the number of combinations modulo 1000000007.
hints: Let ways[v] be the number of combinations that make value v.
To count combinations rather than orderings, loop over coins in the outer loop and values in the inner loop.
ways[0] is 1 (use no coins); take the remainder at every addition.
